_honest_caveat: Canonical grokking is single-table memorize->generalize in weight space. Here the task is in-context PER-EPISODE rule inference (infer rule from 24 examples -> apply), which is NOT classic grokking. Delayed generalization MAY simply not apply. A negative is informative but the analogy is imperfect; do not over-read either outcome.
_purpose: Test whether the rung0 capability-witness failure SURVIVES a long-horizon, regularized (grokking) training regime, i.e. whether the minimal-probe 'budget-bound falsified / family-limited' lean was confounded by early-stop (~6k steps). Candidate-free; capacity FROZEN; NOT a TLGP-R2 run; makes NO H0/H1 claim.
_underpowered_by_design: 3 seeds < N_SEEDS=10. route_decision.py on this data returns inconclusive_underpowered BY DESIGN. The SIGNAL is the val-curve shape + trend, not a formal terminal.
canonical_hash_scheme: sha256 over this object with all keys prefixed '_' recursively removed; json.dumps(sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=True).

capacity_FROZEN.note: same prereg saturation witness as the minimal probe; capacity is NOT a variable here

claim_ceiling: Bounded trend/lean on the TRAINING-REGIME lever only. Proves nothing about transfer (rung3/H1), mechanism, learning-as-mechanism, capability-witness feasibility as a formal terminal, agency, self, subjectivity, AGI, or EGO. Even grok_positive only unlocks drafting a powered sweep; even grok_negative is a lean (underpowered, 1 config, GRU witness untested).

cost_bound.runs: 6 (3 seeds x 2 weight_decay) to max_steps_primary 50000 (~8x the minimal probe's step count)
cost_bound.wall_clock_cap_per_run: operator-set; if exceeded, record the partial curve + mark budget_capped; do NOT silently extend

go_no_go_predeclared._claim: spend-gating / lean ONLY; NOT a scientific route terminal; thresholds are pre-frozen here and may not be tuned after results.
go_no_go_predeclared.ambiguous: anything else (e.g. train never fits, or partial uncrossed rise) -> report numbers + curves, escalate to operator; do NOT auto-decide.
go_no_go_predeclared.grok_negative_family_limited: across all runs, train_balacc reaches >= 0.95 (fit) but heldout stays <= 0.60 with NO sustained late rise through max_steps -> DOWNGRADE: training regime ruled out; honest family/capacity-limited lean for this learner at frozen capacity; route hold/downgrade.
go_no_go_predeclared.grok_positive_escalate: best (seed,wd) rung0 heldout >= 0.75 by max_steps, OR a delayed-generalization signature: heldout rises >= +0.15 AND is sustained over >= 3 consecutive checkpoints AFTER train_balacc first reaches >= 0.95 -> ESCALATE: draft a full powered (10-seed) grokking-regime sweep card. NOT route_open (still underpowered).

prereg_binding.world_rung0_source: read-only import of TLGP-R2 world + rung0 data construction; NO edit to src/tlgp_001b_r2/* or src/tlgp_001a/*
